facts.fact: The Administration Générale des Domaines announced it has begun registering all contracts and putting final copies online after fee payment by mobile payment apps, via the Lagoud platform.

systems.owner: Administration Générale des Domaines et du patrimoine de l'État

facts.fact: The Administration Générale des Domaines says it registers all contracts digitally on the Lagoud platform for real estate documents, with final copies delivered by e-mail or WhatsApp.
